name: Vehicle Enhancements
summary: Store table: running cost, wagon weight and length, figures coloured against the vehicle replaced
description:
Improvements to buying vehicles. Each feature can be turned off in the mod's Settings (the gear next to the mod when choosing a game's mods). Settings also has a Logging switch, off by default, that writes the mod's messages to the game log (stdout.txt) for bug reports.

Running Cost Column: the vehicle store's table layout shows each vehicle's price on its buy button but not what it costs to run. With this mod a column right after the buy button shows the running cost a year, the same figure the store's list layout shows under the price. Click its header to sort by it.

Replace Comparison: when replacing a vehicle, the store's list layout can compare each vehicle with the one being replaced, but the table layout compares nothing. With this mod each figure in the table (capacity, speed, loading speed, power, noise, pollution, comfort and the running cost) is green where the vehicle is better than the one replaced and red where it is worse. The bars show it too, in the same green or red, with a white line where the replaced vehicle's value sits. Better means more capacity, speed, power and comfort, and less noise, pollution and running cost. Capacity and running cost also show the difference from the replaced vehicle under the figure. Hover a figure to see both values and the difference. The store's list layout draws its own Compare bars the same way. As in the store's own comparison, this shows when every vehicle being replaced is the same model. For trains and trams, each locomotive row is compared with the locomotive of the train being replaced, each wagon row with its wagons, and railcars and multiple units likewise, whenever all of that kind in the trains being replaced are the same model. The table compares the same way when modifying a train (for example to swap its locomotive or wagons), against the train as it is now.

Wagon Weight and Length: the store's list layout shows a vehicle's weight and length, the table layout doesn't. With this mod the table's Wagons tab (trains and trams) shows each wagon's weight and length right after its capacity, and drops the Power column, which is always empty for wagons. Both sort by the figure per cargo item (per passenger for a passenger wagon), so small and big wagons can be compared: the wagon's empty weight or length divided by its capacity. Hover a weight or length to see that figure. When replacing or modifying trains whose wagons are all the same model, the tooltip also shows the current wagon's figure and whether the new one is more or less, and the weight or length turns green where the wagon is lighter or shorter per cargo item and red where it is heavier or longer (with Replace Comparison on).

params.name: Running Cost Column
params.tooltip: The vehicle store's table layout shows each vehicle's running cost a year next to its price.

params.name: Wagon Weight and Length
params.tooltip:
On the Wagons tab of the store's table layout, each wagon's weight and length after its capacity
(the empty Power column goes), sorted per cargo item. Their tooltips give the figure per cargo item;
when replacing or modifying, each is green where it is less per cargo item than the current wagon's,
red where it is more.

params.name: Replace Comparison
params.tooltip:
When replacing or modifying a vehicle, the store's table layout shows each figure in green where a vehicle
is better than the one replaced, red where it is worse, with a line on the bars at the replaced vehicle.
The list layout's Compare bars get the same look.

params.name: Logging
params.tooltip: Writes the mod's messages to the game log (stdout.txt), for bug reports.
